about: Claims were written by hand for this page (a model copies the quote in the pipeline; the checker does not care who wrote it). Verdicts come from x3dtrace, plain code.

sets.label: Scene E2: Cornell box
sets.blurb: Statements about the lab's Leg E scene, each with a quote copied from the scene text.

claims.note: A light has no geometry: the report falls back to the whole scene's box, and the page draws a marker at the light's location instead.

claims.statement: The point light sits at height 4.6 m, under the ceiling panel.
The tall box is 1.5 by 3 by 1.5 m.
claims.note: The box drawn is the world box of the turned box, not its local size.

claims.statement: The short box is a 1.5 m cube.
claims.note: One number stands for three equal components (the broadcast conversion).

claims.statement: The tall box is turned 0.30 rad about the vertical axis.

claims.note: This quote occurs 5 times (floor, ceiling, back wall, both boxes). With no hint the box goes to the first one, which happens to be the floor.

claims.statement: The back wall is the same 0.73 grey.
claims.note: Verified, and boxed at the FLOOR: the same quote, no hint. Verified does not prove it is the right place.

claims.statement: The back wall is the same 0.73 grey (with the node named).
claims.note: Same quote, plus the path of the node it is about: now boxed at the back wall.

claims.statement: The camera's field of view is 36.87 degrees.
claims.note: Arithmetic is right (0.6435 rad = 36.87 deg) but the quote carries no unit, so a conversion is not accepted: check.

claims.statement: PLANTED: the point light has intensity 120.
PLANTED: the right wall is red.
claims.note: Planted error: the left wall's numbers, the right wall's quote.

claims.statement: PLANTED: the point light has intensity 8.
claims.note: Planted error: a quote that is not in the scene.

claims.statement: PLANTED: the left wall is red (paraphrased quote).
claims.note: Planted error: the writer did not copy the text exactly.
